summary: In the November 2026 Visa Bulletin, F1 Final Action Dates advanced for 4 of 5 chargeability areas and held steady for 1.
All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India each moved up 366 days (≈12.0 months) to Jan 22, 2021. Mexico advanced 14 days (≈0.5 months) to Sep 22, 2008.
The Philippines stayed at Nov 1, 2013. For I-485 filing, USCIS says to use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) this month.

sections.heading: F1 Final Action Dates advanced for four areas and held for the Philippines
paragraphs: The F1 category covers unmarried sons and daughters of U.S. citizens. In the November 2026 Visa Bulletin, the Final Action Date (Table A) for All other countries moved from Jan 22, 2020 to Jan 22, 2021, an advance of 366 days (≈12.0 months). China (mainland-born) and India show the same move, from Jan 22, 2020 to Jan 22, 2021.

Mexico advanced 14 days (≈0.5 months), from Sep 8, 2008 to Sep 22, 2008. The Philippines had no change and remains at Nov 1, 2013. The 366-day moves for All other countries, China and India are the largest this month.

sections.heading: Dates for Filing (Table B) rose for three areas, and USCIS is accepting Table B for I-485
paragraphs: For November 2026, USCIS says family-sponsored applicants use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) for Form I-485. If your priority date is earlier than the Table B date for your category and country, you may be able to file your adjustment of status application this month. Other eligibility requirements still apply.

The F1 Table B date for All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India advanced 366 days (≈12.0 months), from Feb 1, 2020 to Feb 1, 2021. Mexico had no change and stays at Dec 1, 2008. The Philippines had no change and stays at Apr 22, 2015.

sections.heading: Table B is 10 days ahead for most areas, but 537 days ahead for the Philippines
paragraphs: Table B dates are later than Table A dates, so they let more priority dates qualify. For F1 this month, Table B is 10 days (≈0.3 months) ahead of Table A for All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India. For Mexico, Table B is 70 days (≈2.3 months) ahead of Table A.
The Philippines has the widest gap in F1 this month: Table B (Apr 22, 2015) is 537 days (≈17.6 months) ahead of Table A (Nov 1, 2013).

sections.heading: Six- and twelve-month Final Action Date history for F1 shows no retrogression
paragraphs: This history covers Final Action Dates (Table A) only. For All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India, the last 6 bulletins (since May 2026) moved from Sep 1, 2017 to Jan 22, 2021, a net +1239 days (≈40.7 months). The date advanced in 4 bulletins, was unchanged in 2 and retrogressed in 0. Over the last 12 bulletins (since November 2025), it moved from Nov 8, 2016 to Jan 22, 2021, a net +1536 days (≈50.5 months). It advanced in 6, was unchanged in 6 and retrogressed in 0.

Mexico moved from Aug 15, 2007 to Sep 22, 2008 over the last 6 bulletins, a net +404 days (≈13.3 months), advancing in 5 and unchanged in 1. Over 12 bulletins it moved from Nov 22, 2005 to Sep 22, 2008, a net +1035 days (≈34.0 months), advancing in 10 and unchanged in 2.

The Philippines moved from May 1, 2013 to Nov 1, 2013 over the last 6 bulletins, a net +184 days (≈6.0 months), advancing in 1 and unchanged in 5. Over 12 bulletins it moved from Jan 22, 2013 to Nov 1, 2013, a net +283 days (≈9.3 months), advancing in 3 and unchanged in 9. None of these areas retrogressed in either period.

faq.q: What is the F1 Final Action Date for November 2026?
faq.a: For All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India, it is Jan 22, 2021. Mexico is Sep 22, 2008, and the Philippines is Nov 1, 2013. Final Action Dates are in Table A.

faq.q: Which chart does USCIS accept for F1 I-485 filing in November 2026?
faq.a: USCIS says family-sponsored applicants use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) this month. If your priority date is earlier than the Table B date for your country, you may be able to file. Other eligibility requirements still apply.

faq.q: What is the F1 Dates for Filing (Table B) date for November 2026?
faq.a: For All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India, it is Feb 1, 2021. Mexico is Dec 1, 2008, and the Philippines is Apr 22, 2015.

faq.q: Did F1 dates move forward in November 2026?
faq.a: Final Action Dates advanced for All other countries, China and India by 366 days (≈12.0 months), and for Mexico by 14 days (≈0.5 months). The Philippines had no change. Table B advanced for the first three areas only.
